assessment.nobel_worthiness: GLP-1 physiology and incretin-based therapy link a basic hormone discovery to a treatment class that has changed management of type 2 diabetes and obesity, with growing evidence in cardiovascular and renal outcomes. The chain from proglucagon processing to the active peptide, its insulinotropic and satiety actions and stable agonists is original, clear and of lasting impact.
assessment.attribution: Holst (physiology of the active truncated GLP-1 and its clinical relevance), Mojsov (identification and synthesis of the active peptide) and Drucker (biology of GLP-1 and GLP-2 and translational work) form a coherent trio. Lotte Bjerre Knudsen led industrial development of the agonists, which is valuable but arguably a different kind of contribution. Credit for the original peptide work, where others besides Mojsov may have contributed, is not resolved by the supplied names.
assessment.maturity: Clinical efficacy is confirmed in large independent trials and by wide use, and the mechanism is stable. Recognition is timely, even pressing.
uncertainties: Whether the original peptide-identification credit can be fairly limited to the credited names I may not recall precisely.
Choice between basic and industrial contributors is contested.
Long-term safety and outcome data are still accumulating.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Engineered CAR-T cells turned a conceptual design into a living drug that induces durable remissions in refractory B-cell leukemias and lymphomas and now myeloma, and it is spreading into autoimmunity. Originality and clinical impact are very high.
assessment.attribution: Sadelain contributed early CAR design including costimulation (CD28), and June contributed 4-1BB-based CARs and the clinical translation that led to the first approved products. Rosenberg's work on adoptive cell transfer and early CAR trials is important, but a two-person prize captures the engineering and the clinical proof. Other early contributors (for example Eshhar) are not in the supplied credit, which complicates a fair configuration.
assessment.maturity: Multiple approved products with independent confirmation and years of follow-up. Recognition is timely, although toxicity, solid-tumor limits and cost remain open.
uncertainties: Early-credit disputes over the original chimeric receptor concept are not captured by the supplied names.
Long-term durability and secondary malignancy risk are still being defined.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: The unfolded protein response revealed a new form of organelle-to-nucleus signalling and a general principle of proteostasis, with IRE1, XBP1, ATF6 and PERK arms. It has shaped understanding of secretory-cell physiology, neurodegeneration, metabolic disease and cancer, and is a conceptually clean discovery.
assessment.attribution: Walter and Mori identified the IRE1 mechanism, the HAC1 unconventional splicing and the UPR transcriptional program, and they form a natural pair. Others (for example Ron on PERK and the integrated stress response, Kaufman) also contributed, so the pair does not cover the full field.
assessment.maturity: Thirty years of independent confirmation and mechanistic stability. Therapeutic translation is only emerging, which is acceptable for a basic-science prize.
uncertainties: Contributions of Ron, Kaufman and others to the broader UPR/ISR may be seen as needing recognition.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: cGAS-STING defines how cytosolic DNA is sensed and converted to a second messenger (cGAMP) that drives interferon responses. It underlies antiviral defence, autoimmunity (interferonopathies), cancer immunity and ageing, and it is a clear, mechanistic discovery.
assessment.attribution: Chen discovered cGAS and cGAMP as the second messenger, and Barber identified STING. Other credited people (Wu, Sun, Ishikawa) were mainly trainees or coauthors on these papers, so a two-person configuration looks well supported. Contributions from Vance, Patel and others on cyclic dinucleotides are not in the credit.
assessment.maturity: The pathway is confirmed independently with structure, genetics and disease links. Therapeutic agonists and antagonists are still in development, so clinical maturity is moderate, but the basic science is secure.
uncertainties: Therapeutic benefit is not yet established.
Credit for the discovery of STING (several groups in 2008-2009) and for cyclic dinucleotide sensing is not fully settled.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: TNF blockade proved that a single cytokine could be a therapeutic target in chronic inflammatory disease, and anti-TNF drugs transformed rheumatoid arthritis, Crohn's disease and psoriasis care. Impact on patients is enormous and the translational logic was original.
assessment.attribution: Feldmann and Maini showed TNF's role in synovial inflammation and ran the first clinical trials with infliximab, a natural pair. Antibody engineering (for example by Vilcek/Centocor teams) and TNF's discovery are separate contributions outside the credited names.
assessment.maturity: Decades of use, biosimilars and replicated trials make it mature, and some may consider it overdue.
uncertainties: Credit for the TNF molecule and antibody development may be viewed as separate from the clinical-proof contribution.
The discovery already has major prior recognition (Lasker).

assessment.nobel_worthiness: BCR-ABL inhibition by imatinib is the prototype of molecularly targeted cancer therapy, turning chronic myeloid leukemia into a manageable disease. Its importance and clarity are very high, and it validated the oncogene-addiction concept clinically.
assessment.attribution: Lydon (medicinal chemistry and kinase-inhibitor program), Druker (clinical proof and the selective effect on BCR-ABL cells) and Sawyers (resistance mechanisms and second-generation inhibitors) is a plausible trio. Nowell, Rowley, Witte, Baltimore and others made the earlier BCR-ABL discoveries and are not on this list. Buchdunger and Zimmermann (Ciba-Geigy/Novartis chemistry) are not credited.
assessment.maturity: Long follow-up and independent confirmation are strong, and the field has been recognised with a Lasker (2009), so timing is arguably late rather than premature.
uncertainties: The industrial contributor set may be incomplete.
Whether the prize should instead recognise the preceding BCR-ABL discoveries is open.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Virus-like particle HPV vaccines prevent persistent infection and cervical precancer, and national programmes now show population-level decreases in cervical neoplasia. It is preventive medicine with major, measurable global effect, and zur Hausen's earlier prize established the cause.
assessment.attribution: Lowy and Schiller developed L1 VLPs at the NCI, and Frazer (with Zhou) developed VLP expression and the Gardasil-related technology. Credit for the University of Queensland work (Jian Zhou, deceased) and for the competing Georgetown and Rochester groups creates a real attribution complication.
assessment.maturity: Population-level evidence from independent cohorts supports effectiveness, including recent evidence on cancer reduction. Recognition is timely.
uncertainties: Patent disputes and the multi-group history complicate fair credit.
Cancer-endpoint data are still maturing in some settings.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Optogenetics gave neuroscience a way to control defined cell types with millisecond precision, and it has transformed circuit analysis. The invention is original and has had a large methodological impact. Its direct medical impact (for example vision restoration) is only beginning.
assessment.attribution: Channelrhodopsin discovery and characterisation (Nagel, Hegemann, Bamberg), first neuronal use (Boyden and Deisseroth, and Miesenböck's earlier work with other tools). With six credited names and no clear limit to three, a prize allocation will be contested.
assessment.maturity: Widely validated across species and labs, so technically mature. Therapeutic validation is early.
uncertainties: Attribution among six or more people is difficult and disputed.
Whether this fits best as a physiology/medicine or a methods prize is uncertain.
